description.value: A Subway franchise on Main Street in Penticton serving made-to-order footlongs, 6" sandwiches, wraps, and salads with fresh-cut vegetables and fresh-baked bread. This independently owned and operated location offers in-restaurant dining, curbside pickup, and delivery, making it a quick and flexible stop for cyclists passing through town. Breakfast items are also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Subway franchise at 1636 Main Sreet #110, Penticton, BC V2A 5G8 with phone (250) 770-7827, matching OSM tags. OSM takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's 'Order Pick Up' and 'Curbside Pickup' service options. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Both the OSM URL slug and Subway's own website consistently misspell the street as 'Main Sreet' instead of 'Main Street' — this appears to be a data-entry error in Subway's system that has propagated to OSM.
OSM address omits the unit number (#110) visible on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant confirmed by active website with current hours and ordering. A practical food and calorie stop for touring cyclists on Main Street.
